checklist_source: User-pasted condensed master checklist, 2026-10-19. Requirements, not pre-passed tests.

status_definitions.VERIFIED: Direct executed evidence supports the scenario on the audited source within its stated scope; this is not proof of all inputs or current upstream.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some clauses covered; a named coverage or policy gap remains.
status_definitions.OPEN: The specific requirement is not yet demonstrated.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: A required external prerequisite is missing; reporting the block does not complete the feature.

SUITE.scope: Audited source 77eefac; formatting, Clippy all/local/cache, 1014 library + 47 main + 7 CLI + 23 integration tests passed; 2 ignored.

CONFIG.scope: Six SQLite/recovery/pruning/config source-selection controls on audited source.

SQLITE.scope: Readonly writer, busy writer, pruning, stale leases, disable/cancel/reopen and source selection.

ROUTE.scope: Natural expiry, reopened DB/workers, recording sendmail, paused transport and three actual NNTP replays. Completed review supplied as fixture.

NATIVE.scope: Maximum actual series, history read fault, separate-process restart and owner-query comparison.

FAULT.scope: ENOSPC, EIO, partial WAL write and SIGKILL before/after COMMIT. Software model, not physical power failure.

CONCUR.scope: 16 independent DB handles, 128 admissions, 128 replays and 64 release markers over eight scopes.

OLD.scope: Old/new native DB code on temporary fixture; unsafe copy, quiescence/cancellation and safe access. Not a production-daemon downgrade.

PERF.scope: Upstream base 715294a, disabled and enabled traces; unchanged ratio-of-medians limits; all raw samples retained.

PROBE.scope: Calibrated SQL API counters and writer boundary timing; independent diagnostic run.

MUT.scope: Five compiled, killed mutants; unrelated positive controls and restored replay.

PREP.scope: Source-only commits pass make check-pr before creation and sign-off checks; bundled head ecf8f138dac130324b88119eec19c87623c0cbe7.

scenarios.requirement: Default/absent setting preserves all existing behavior.
scenarios.evidence: SUITE; PERF legacy tuple equality; test_cooldown_legacy_has_no_intent_or_events.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Differential trace omits fixed embargo settings; complete the legacy configuration matrix.

scenarios.requirement: Explicitly disabled differs correctly from omitted.
scenarios.evidence: CONFIG; explicit_enablement_templates_and_strict_types.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Confirm intended omitted/false inheritance semantics with maintainers and test both through ingestion.

scenarios.requirement: Zero delays and inherited settings retain their meanings.
scenarios.evidence: hand_checked_linear_thresholds_and_composition preserves None/Some(0); CONFIG templates.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Validate database/route zero fixed-delay combinations. Adaptive zero limits are currently rejected; confirm that policy.

scenarios.requirement: Invalid limits and contradictory settings fail safely.
scenarios.evidence: explicit_enablement_templates_and_strict_types; hand_checked_linear_thresholds_and_composition.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Bounds, strict types, step/cap contradictions and overflow reject; resource ceilings are not deployment defaults.

scenarios.requirement: Unknown configuration fields and CLI options are rejected.
scenarios.evidence: CONFIG strict TOML; test_rejects_unknown_fields_and_invalid_keys; test_unknown_project_is_rejected_by_the_parser.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Add an explicit unknown CLI-flag rejection check for the relevant profiles.

scenarios.requirement: Cross-posted lists respect precedence and opt-outs.
scenarios.evidence: CONFIG source/recipient matrix; test_cooldown_crosspost_before_admission_is_legacy.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Current policy sends any cross-post through shared legacy handling. Maintainer agreement and a full precedence/opt-out matrix are missing.

scenarios.requirement: Configuration reaches the actual production workflow.
scenarios.evidence: ROUTE; test_cooldown_config_to_real_release_and_sendmail.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Real policy file -> parsed NNTP article -> admission/release worker -> recording sendmail; completed review is a fixture.

scenarios.requirement: Existing local review commands and feature profiles still work.
scenarios.evidence: SUITE includes all-feature tests and Clippy all/local/cache profiles; CLI smoke tests.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Run local-review command smoke cases under each minimal feature profile; compile checks alone do not establish runtime behavior.

scenarios.requirement: One patch series counts once, regardless of patch count.
scenarios.evidence: NATIVE maximum 1024-part series; PERF mixed 1/2/4/8-part series; incomplete/out-of-order regression.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: One event per complete canonical revision; covers and individual parts do not multiply activity.

scenarios.requirement: Duplicate messages and replays cannot count twice.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_incomplete_out_of_order_and_duplicate; ROUTE three delivered-message replays; CONCUR.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Frozen decisions and event counts remain unchanged after replay.

scenarios.requirement: Simultaneous duplicate submissions create one event.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_two_connections_own_opposite_parts_once.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: This proves concurrent different parts converge on one owner, not simultaneous identical final-message submissions. Add that exact case.

scenarios.requirement: Concurrent revisions cannot lose accounting updates.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_distinct_connections_serialize_author_history; CONCUR.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: 16 independent handles, 128 admissions, eight scopes, exact saturated-count distribution.

scenarios.requirement: One author's activity cannot penalize another.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_deadline_boundary_clean_exception_and_isolation; author-scope mutant in MUT.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Distinct author has zero prior activity; removing author scope is detected.

scenarios.requirement: Author identity is normalized without merging unknown authors.
scenarios.evidence: identity_normalization_has_no_unknown_bucket; CONFIG invalid-author case.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: ASCII bare mailbox normalization; malformed/unsupported identities error instead of sharing an unknown key. From is unauthenticated.

scenarios.requirement: Late, incomplete, and out-of-order series are handled.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_incomplete_out_of_order_and_duplicate; real_versions_and_late_cover_remain_separate; unbound_adopted_cover_cannot_admit.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Unresolved provenance cannot promote Pending; frozen revisions cannot be extended silently.

scenarios.requirement: Series-size metadata is validated against manipulation.
scenarios.evidence: maximum-series control; owned_content_cannot_change_without_context; same_version_extension_cannot_escape_frozen_owner; large_source_metadata_is_compact_during_admission.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Actual unique indices and source metadata are checked; changed denominator/content quarantines the owner.

scenarios.requirement: First submission and burst thresholds produce expected delays.
scenarios.evidence: hand_checked_linear_thresholds_and_composition; test_cooldown_hand_trace_scope_and_window.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Independent threshold table checks first, burst, linear step and saturation.

scenarios.requirement: Larger series follow the defined limits without overflow.
scenarios.evidence: NATIVE 1024 real parts; core policy bounds/overflow tests.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Current v1 policy has no size multiplier. Policy agreement is an independent completion gate.

scenarios.requirement: Time-window boundary cases are correct.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_hand_trace_scope_and_window.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: History uses (t-W,t]; event exactly on excluded lower boundary drops from the count.

scenarios.requirement: Inactivity resets or decays the cooldown correctly.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_hand_trace_scope_and_window; seeded_restart_replay_trace.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Sliding-window expiration resets the count; no separate exponential decay is implemented.

scenarios.requirement: Forged or incorrect email dates cannot bypass the cooldown.
scenarios.evidence: ROUTE ingests a 1970 Date while local admission establishes the live deadline; seeded hand trace uses independent admission timestamps.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Add future, invalid and extreme Date-header variants through parsed ingestion.

scenarios.requirement: Clock changes, time zones, and timestamp limits are tested.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_coverage_and_backward_clock_fail_closed; negative/overflow calculator tests.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: No explicit TZ/DST environment matrix or forward-jump scheduling matrix has run.

scenarios.requirement: Reviews release at the deadline, never prematurely.
scenarios.evidence: test_cooldown_deadline_boundary_clean_exception_and_isolation; ROUTE natural 30-second expiry.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: No ordinary release at deadline-1; release at deadline. Existing clean/authorized-override exceptions remain valid eligibility paths.

scenarios.requirement: Continuous new submissions cannot postpone an old review forever.
scenarios.evidence: deadline_boundary_clean_exception_and_isolation; frozen replay tests; seeded trace.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Later activity does not move an earlier frozen decision; incremental delay is capped.

scenarios.requirement: Fresh databases and upgraded databases both work.
scenarios.evidence: SUITE fresh migrations, v8/v10 and complete v11 fixture; interim_version14_upgrade_preserves_decision.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Schema 15 retains prototype decisions and repairs the held-series index.

scenarios.requirement: Deadlines and duplicate protection survive restarts.
scenarios.evidence: NATIVE separate-process restart; FAULT post-COMMIT recovery; restart_preserves_decision_and_release.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Reopened workers and processes preserve frozen values and deduplication.

scenarios.requirement: Failed transactions leave no partially committed state.
scenarios.evidence: history_failure_rolls_back_and_retries; SQLITE recovery; FAULT ENOSPC/EIO/precommit/torn-write.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Failed target admission leaves no patch/event; successful retry records one target event.

scenarios.requirement: Crash recovery preserves committed work.
scenarios.evidence: FAULT before/after COMMIT and partial WAL write; NATIVE process exit after commit.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: SIGKILL/torn-write software model passed integrity checks. Physical electrical power loss is not demonstrated.

scenarios.requirement: Concurrent database connections cannot corrupt decisions.
scenarios.evidence: CONCUR; two independent-connection regressions.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: 128 events and replay/release snapshots remain consistent. Scope is the tested bounded workload.

scenarios.requirement: Slow operations do not block unrelated writers.
scenarios.evidence: PROBE paused collaborator; ROUTE gated sendmail; deliberate contention calibration.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: External pauses permit unrelated writes. Unbounded indivisible canonical-owner quarantine remains a documented exception; broad load/fairness is not established.

scenarios.requirement: Database failures are visible and handled safely.
scenarios.evidence: SQLITE read-only/busy controls; FAULT; outbox_and_release_queries_propagate_cursor_step_errors.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Failures surface as errors and do not silently publish or fall back to legacy admission.

scenarios.requirement: History cleanup, configuration changes, and rollback preserve pending work.
scenarios.evidence: SQLITE pruning; policy_reload_preserves_decided_but_blocks_waiting; OLD.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Event pruning retains tombstones. Rehearsed rollback cancels pending/held work; live preservation/resumption and a production-daemon downgrade remain unverified.

scenarios.requirement: Held findings cannot be sent before release eligibility.
scenarios.evidence: ROUTE; live_claims_and_null_patch_notification; quarantine API regression; SQLITE stale leases.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Checks ordinary mail, NULL patch notifications and live claim guards. Remote acceptance already completed cannot be recalled.

scenarios.requirement: Successful clean reviews retain existing immediate-release behavior.
scenarios.evidence: test_clean_patchset_is_releasable_before_embargo_expiry; adaptive deadline_boundary_clean_exception_and_isolation.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: A complete successful no-finding review remains eligible before its time deadline.

scenarios.requirement: Failed or incomplete reviews cannot masquerade as clean.
scenarios.evidence: test_no_ai_review_is_not_clean; clean predicate and failure handling tests in SUITE.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Add a feature-specific release matrix for failed, missing, partially completed and mixed review outputs.

scenarios.requirement: Superseded versions are cancelled without blocking newer ones.
scenarios.evidence: held supersession prerequisite regressions; held-series partial-index/candidate-capacity checks.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Unpublished Reviewed predecessors and unsent outboxes cancel atomically; release race remains protected.

scenarios.requirement: Multiple workers cannot claim the same queue item incorrectly.
scenarios.evidence: Atomic claim SQL; sequential double-claim/lease tests; restarted-worker dedup in ROUTE.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Add simultaneous independent release/email-worker claims for the same eligible item. Admission concurrency is not publication-claim concurrency.

scenarios.requirement: Retries, leases, and cooldown deadlines cooperate correctly.
scenarios.evidence: SQLITE stale lease quarantine/reopen; ROUTE expiry/restart/replay; release claim lease tests.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Expired claims are rechecked against live guards. Exactly-once SMTP acceptance/acknowledgement is outside this evidence.

scenarios.requirement: Authorized early release works; unauthorized release is denied.
scenarios.evidence: test_release_patchset_embargo_authorization_and_endpoint; adaptive early-release and quarantine regressions.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Shared ACL route and adaptive DB behavior are separately tested; add their combined enabled-adaptive endpoint matrix.

scenarios.requirement: Mailing-list rules, ignored authors, recipients, visibility, and integrations stay correct.
scenarios.evidence: CONFIG; recording recipient check; server visibility regressions; general router/worker tests.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Missing complete adaptive-enabled ignored-author/routing/integration combinations. Upstream now changes relevant paths.

scenarios.requirement: Held reviews cannot block eligible reviews behind them.
scenarios.evidence: Eligibility predicates precede LIMIT in current selectors; no direct head-of-queue starvation fixture identified.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Add held/waiting/quarantined head items followed by eligible review and outbox items, including worker limits.

scenarios.requirement: Forged identities or subjects cannot cause unbounded penalties.
scenarios.evidence: Identity validation, fixed increment cap, frozen deadlines, source/metadata quarantine.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: No comprehensive adversarial/fairness corpus. Forged/shared From addresses can affect another person using the same key; document and obtain policy agreement.

scenarios.requirement: Ambiguous series titles and revision histories do not collide.
scenarios.evidence: real_versions_and_late_cover_remain_separate; mixed_canonical_merge_blocks_before_moving_rows; late_cover_recovers_explicit_part_version.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Supported versions remain separate; unsupported ownership reconciliation quarantines before mutation.

scenarios.requirement: Large series and activity histories remain resource-bounded.
scenarios.evidence: NATIVE 1024 parts; indexed bounded history; PROBE retained-owner comparison; pruning control.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Permanent tombstones are not globally storage-bounded; canonical multiowner quarantine is an unbounded indivisible group. No blanket bounded-writer claim.

scenarios.requirement: Malformed input cannot cause injection or uncontrolled allocation.
scenarios.evidence: Strict config/mailbox/ID validation, bound checks and parameterized SQL; compact facts with 1 MiB subject.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: No complete malformed-input fuzz/allocation bound audit across ingestion. Outside-writer preprocessing still allocates in proportion to input.

scenarios.requirement: Cancellation cleans up tasks and prevents indefinite hangs.
scenarios.evidence: Cancellation regressions, timeout child-reaping tests, bounded hosted subprocesses, OLD quiescence.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Add adaptive-specific in-flight review/transport cancellation coverage; remote acceptance cannot be undone.

scenarios.requirement: Diagnostics do not expose private information or credentials.
scenarios.evidence: Quarantine hides direct public review/log endpoints; general redaction tests; diagnostic counters omit SQL payloads.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: No dedicated held-content/secret-canary audit over all new logs and manifests. Raw model review logging remains untested.

scenarios.requirement: Read-only replay cannot alter real database or repository state.
scenarios.evidence: Existing generated/fault replays use temporary databases and restored ephemeral source.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: No historical read-only shadow-replay tool/corpus and pristine-state guard have been validated.

scenarios.requirement: At least one integration test exercises the complete affected workflow.
scenarios.evidence: ROUTE and test_cooldown_config_to_real_release_and_sendmail.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Policy -> real parsed article -> DB -> completed-review fixture -> release worker -> recording transport. No model call; review-computation boundary is explicit.

scenarios.requirement: Expected results are calculated independently of production code.
scenarios.evidence: Hand-checked threshold table; seeded small-state oracle; fixed expected concurrent count distribution.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Expected values are not obtained by invoking the production cooldown calculator.

scenarios.requirement: Regression tests fail when their intended protection is removed.
scenarios.evidence: MUT five compiled mutants with targeted negative tests and unrelated positive controls.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Author scope, frozen replay, deadline comparison, release marker and NNTP eligibility mutants are killed.

scenarios.requirement: Generated tests reproduce restart, replay, and concurrency failures.
scenarios.evidence: Three seeded 96-admission traces; source-race regressions; CONCUR; process/crash controls.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Coverage is bounded and reproducible, not an exhaustive interleaving proof.

scenarios.requirement: Small, large, and mixed workloads are tested.
scenarios.evidence: PERF 1000 series/3750 parts; NATIVE 1024-part series; compact metadata with 1 MiB subject; 10000 archived owners.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Generated/synthetic workload sizes are recorded; no historical replay is implied.

scenarios.requirement: Measure enabled versus disabled performance and database costs.
scenarios.evidence: PERF; PROBE.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Matched base/disabled/enabled medians, raw samples, SQL API counts and calibrated writer distributions recorded. One fresh pair exceeds the nominal ratio limit.

scenarios.requirement: Run the required test suites on the exact final code revision.
scenarios.evidence: SUITE and PREP pass on the audited source and source-only tree.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: The current candidate is tested; upstream refresh/final review may change it. Re-run on that exact final tree before submission.

scenarios.requirement: Test harness detects invalid fixtures and misleading passes.
scenarios.evidence: Exact one-test assertions, compiler artifact checks, SQL calibration, OS fault-hit markers, SIGKILL exit checks, restored-source controls.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Earlier invalid fixtures and a wrongly selected mutation target are documented and corrected; no invalid pass is reused.

scenarios.requirement: Record tested commit, command, environment, logs, and outcome.
scenarios.evidence: SUITE/PREP/PERF/PROBE/FAULT/CONCUR/OLD artifacts and workflows; round-3 report.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Artifacts retain commands, hashes, native binaries or manifests and runner logs; retention is 14 days, so durable preservation remains necessary.

scenarios.requirement: Distinguish upstream failures from newly introduced failures.
scenarios.evidence: Matched upstream performance; prerequisite diagnostic; recorded harness failures.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: The latest upstream full suite has not been run. Refresh and compare failures explicitly before final attribution.

scenarios.requirement: Refresh against upstream and revalidate the final diff.
scenarios.evidence: Upstream now 7f92f869a960a20f7d395550b4879d897ebdf4ea, 16 commits beyond tested base.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Refresh with overlapping main/review/email/server changes, inspect conflict resolutions and revalidate. PR 685 remains open/unmerged.

scenarios.requirement: Do not claim email or token savings without real measurements.
scenarios.evidence: Design and reports make no savings claim; all review outputs are fixtures in deterministic tests.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Cooldown delays publication; no token/email reduction measurement or claim has been made.

scenarios.requirement: Preserve negative results and document fairness tradeoffs.
scenarios.evidence: Previous FAIL_BUDGET runs, raw paired ratios and corrected harness failures retained; design limitations.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Includes unauthenticated/shared authors, cold history, retained storage and indivisible quarantine limitations.

scenarios.requirement: Required model-assisted self-review is completed or explicitly marked blocked.
scenarios.evidence: All reports explicitly mark required Sashiko review pending; no model invocation or spend.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: Disclosure requirement is met, but the mandatory completion gate is not. Secret readiness is unconfirmed.

scenarios.requirement: Rehearse dry-run, rollback, and pending-work preservation.
scenarios.evidence: ROUTE uses local recording transport; OLD rehearses stop/cancel and old DB access.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: No full production-daemon downgrade or complete dry-run/pending-work continuation matrix. Do not substitute cancellation evidence for preservation of runnable work.

scenarios.requirement: No unauthorized emails, pushes, deployment changes, secret leaks, or paid calls.
scenarios.evidence: Authorized fork-only checkpoints; temporary recording transports; no upstream PR/deployment/model calls.
scenarios.remaining_or_scope: No external mail or paid AI call was made by this work. Source publication remains separately gated.

completion_gates.requirement: Verify the feature is still missing in current upstream.
completion_gates.assessment: At upstream 7f92f869a960a20f7d395550b4879d897ebdf4ea, checked db.rs/email_policy.rs contain no adaptive_cooldown, CooldownContext or review_cooldown persistence/configuration. This is the target feature check, not an assertion that fixed embargoes are missing.

completion_gates.requirement: Recover historical tests and identify coverage gaps.
completion_gates.assessment: Existing clean-review, no-AI, release-ACL, supersession and failure tests were inspected and mapped. The complete historical corpus/shadow replay and prior change-history audit are not complete.

completion_gates.requirement: Get maintainer agreement on the intended cooldown policy.
completion_gates.assessment: No recorded upstream maintainer agreement. Resolve policy semantics, zero values, cross-post/opt-out precedence, author normalization/fairness, cap and indivisible ownership-group exceptions. No outreach was performed.
Prerequisite and feature are split in source-only artifacts; duplicate SQL reads were removed. Scope/minimality and the unbounded ownership exception still need maintainer/model review.

completion_gates.requirement: Run all applicable regression and integration tests.
completion_gates.assessment: Audited candidate checks pass; 23 partial and 3 open scenario rows still identify missing coverage. Latest-upstream refreshed final tree does not yet exist.

Declared median screening limits pass on audited source; query reduction is measured. Raw fresh pair above 20%, synthetic workloads and writer outliers are explicitly retained; no production performance guarantee.
Required local Sashiko model review not run; provider-secret readiness unconfirmed. Subsequent upstream bot findings can only be handled after separately approved submission.
Matched baseline/disabled trace is equal within its scope, but current upstream is 16 commits newer with overlapping changes. Full refreshed comparison and final-tree checks required.

completion_gates.requirement: Produce reproducible evidence with exact commit hashes.
completion_gates.assessment: Evidence index records source, baseline, source-only tree, workflow commands, logs, hashes and outcomes. Artifacts have 14-day retention and need durable preservation.

completion_gates.requirement: Prepare a clean PR for separate approval before publishing.
completion_gates.assessment: Clean two-commit source-only bundle and draft materials exist. Refresh, policy agreement, gaps and model review remain; no upstream PR was submitted.

definition_of_complete: The applicable tests pass, limitations are documented, existing behavior is preserved when disabled, and the implementation is ready for maintainer review—not merely that the checklist has been ticked.
